caption: The drawing depicts an apron with a fitted waistband and a single pocket on the left side. The main portion of the apron is colored light pink with fine brown lines suggesting a woven or textured fabric, and it has a deeper pink tie extending from the right side. A small rectangular patch is visible above the pocket. The pocket itself is depicted with a beige or light brown color on its inner side. The outline of a larger, pale garment beneath the apron is present, likely representing a dress or skirt, and it is drawn using thin black lines. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, uncolored outline of the apron showing its shape and the placement of the waistband, tie, and pocket. The background of the drawing is a light tan, gradually darkening toward the top edge.
title: Apron
